categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label, modifies test_runner.py, and adds feature_dbcrash_replay.py to standard functional test runs.
categories.rationale: Adds fast, deterministic functional test coverage for a high-risk crash recovery code path in Chainstate::ReplayBlocks that previously ran only in extended non-CI scripts. The ~1-second test catches realistic regressions, specifically killing two off-by-one mutants in block replay loops.
